notes: Reference token prices used to turn a submission's token counts into a monetary cost on the leaderboard's cost-performance chart. Proprietary models use the vendor's list API price. Open-weight models have no vendor price, so they carry a public hosted-inference quote for the same weights as a reference rate; that is a market price for someone else's serving, not the submitter's own cost. Every entry records the date its quote was collected in `retrieved`; vendor and hosted prices both move, so re-check before citing. Prices are editable in the UI without changing this file.

GPT-5-mini.note: OpenAI has announced this model shuts down 2026-12-11; the price will stop being refreshable after that.

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8.note: Quote for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; the run used the vendor's FP8 checkpoint of the same weights.

Qwen3.8-27B-FP8.note: Quote for Qwen3.8-27B; the run used the vendor's FP8 checkpoint. This is a hosted reference estimate, not the self-hosted run's GPU bill.

OTel-2.0-LLM-31B-IT.note: Developer API quote for the FP8 deployment of this model; the submitted run used self-hosted BF16 weights. This is a hosted reference estimate, not the run's GPU bill. Cached-input discounts are not applied.

gemma-4-31B-it.note: Hosted reference quote for Gemma 4 31B Instruct. The run used self-hosted BF16; provider serving precision is not specified in this quote. This estimate is not the self-hosted GPU bill.

TelecomGPT-R1.note: Public model API quote for KU-DFI/TelecomGPT-R1 (27B), confirmed against the model page. Provider serving precision is not specified. This is a hosted reference estimate, not the self-hosted GPU bill; cached-input discounts are not applied.

GLM-4.7-Flash.note: OpenRouter list price for z-ai/glm-4.7-flash from its public model API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models); providers serve fp8, bf16, or unspecified precision. This is a hosted reference estimate, not the self-hosted GPU bill; cached-input discounts are not applied.

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Anthropic standard API list prices in USD per million tokens, used as a reference estimate rather than the actual Claude subscription cost. Input usage includes cached tokens; cache discounts are not represented by this catalog's input/output-only rates.
